name: Pregnancy
overview: Scripture reveals God's intimate involvement in the miracle of pregnancy, as seen when He hears affliction and grants a child (Genesis 16:11) and answers prayers for conception (Genesis 25:21). The sanctity of life in the womb is affirmed by the Creator who fashions each person there (Job 31:15), and the protection of both mother and child is mandated (Exodus 21:22). God's blessings extend to the fruit of the womb as a sign of His covenantal favor and provision (Deuteronomy 7:13), underscoring the sacredness and purpose of pregnancy within His design.
